description:
FLYPKIN FK007: Your Daily Companion for Effortless Mobility

➤➤Power Through Your Day, Every Day

Powered by a robust 350W thermally controlled motor, the FK007 conquers steep hills and urban shortcuts with ease, hitting speeds up to 19 mph—ideal for zipping past traffic during rush hour, catching the next lecture across campus, or making quick trips to the grocery store. Its 36V5.2Ah battery delivers 21-33 km (17-23 miles) per charge, ensuring you’re always ready for back-to-back errands or a spontaneous evening ride.

➤➤Engineered for Safety & Adaptability

Tackle uneven pavements, wet roads, or cobblestone paths confidently with 8.5-inch tires. The ultra-bright LED headlight and responsive brake-activated taillight keep you visible during foggy mornings or late-night commutes. Dual braking (rear Drum+ electronic ABS) ensures instant, reliable stops, while the Vicont app adds anti-theft protection with remote locking, alarms, and real-time ride tracking.

➤Master Your Ride in Seconds：

Power: Hold button 2s to start/stop (auto-shutdown after 10 mins idle).

⚠️ First-time rider? Start in beginner mode (9 mph) to build confidence.

⚠️ Always wear a helmet—non-negotiable for city commutes or campus rides.

⚠️ Pre-ride check: Tire pressure, brake responsiveness, and battery level.

✅ UL2272 Certified for Superior Safety

Your safety matters! The FK007 meets UL2272 safety standards, providing peace of mind for both adults and teens looking for a secure and convenient way to get around.

Affordable & Powerful for Daily Commutes

Enjoy the perfect balance of performance and value with a 350W motor that reaches speeds up to 19 MPH. Whether you're commuting to work, riding around campus, or cruising on the weekend, this scooter delivers a smooth, sturdy ride with a 264 lbs weight capacity.

Enhanced Safety with Dual Braking System

Stay in control with disc brakes + EABS regenerative anti-lock braking, ensuring fast, reliable stopping power in all riding conditions. Ride with confidence, knowing your scooter is built for maximum safety.

Lightweight & Ultra-Portable Design

Fold it up in just 3 seconds! Weighing only 33 lbs (15 kg), it's easy to carry and store—perfect for commuters, students, and city riders. Fits effortlessly in a trunk, closet, or under a desk.

Long-Range Battery & Quick Charging

With a 36V/7.8Ah high-capacity battery, enjoy up to 21 miles of range on a single charge. The fast 5-6 hour charging and built-in cruise control ensure longer, smoother rides with minimal downtime.
